source.title: WRC Leader Announcement (December 2020)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Committee Leader. Iván Brigidano Pérez will become the new Leader of the WCA Regulations Committee (WRC). Iván was already working as a Member of the WRC.
<!-- break -->
Iván was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote among the current Committee Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our [Motion](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams.

We thank Lucas Garron for the work he has done for the WRC as the Leader, and wish Iván the best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

The Board received applications from the following applicants:
Oleg Gritsenko
 
We thank Oleg for applying and both applications can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1qo27qNac5J1k_JCngz_6l9E99s-ZnKGx).

translation.title: WCA 规则委员会负责人任命公告（2020 年 12 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，Iván Brigidano Pérez 将担任 WCA 规则委员会（WRC）的新负责人。Iván 此前已是 WRC 成员。
<!-- break -->
按照关于 WCA 委员会和团队的[议案](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节，WCA 董事会选定 Iván，并经现任委员会负责人和高级代表投票批准。

感谢 Lucas Garron 在担任 WRC 负责人期间所做的工作，祝 Iván 履新顺利。

董事会还收到了 Oleg Gritsenko 的申请。

感谢 Oleg 参与申请。两人的申请材料均可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1qo27qNac5J1k_JCngz_6l9E99s-ZnKGx)查看。
